code.text: CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, mild normocytic anemia, leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, monocytosis and basophilia. There is also low total CO₂, suggesting possible metabolic acidosis. Renal and liver function, as well as electrolytes, are within normal limits. Findings are suggestive of bone marrow suppression or infiltration and significant respiratory compromise; urgent clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended.
